Mastermind of Mahadev Betting App Arrested in Oman

Saurabh Chandra Kumar, the mastermind behind the Mahadev betting app, has been arrested in Oman. The Enforcement Directorate and Central Bureau of Investigation have reportedly secured a significant success in this case. The arrest is seen as a major development in the ongoing investigation into the Mahadev betting scandal.
